data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to embed GIPHY GIFs and stickers via native SDKs.
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets, dialogs, and video views that search, display, and play GIFs and stickers using GIPHY’s native Android and iOS SDKs. It handles API communication, caching, and customizable UI templates.
use_when: You need rich GIF or sticker content in a Flutter app
You want native performance and caching for media
You want to include GIPHY Clips with sound or animated text
avoid_when: Your app targets iOS versions earlier than 15
You need a purely Dart‑based solution with no native dependencies
You only need static images or offline assets
strengths: Native SDK integration gives fast, reliable media loading
Built‑in widgets (grid, dialog, media view) simplify UI
Supports GIFs, stickers, clips, and animated text
Automatic caching and background playback handling
weaknesses: Platform‑specific setup and potential native code maintenance
No pure Dart alternative, so adds native dependencies
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec, set iOS platform to 15.0 or later in Podfile, ensure Android minSdkVersion supports the native SDK (not specified). No build_runner needed.
